description: Lists experiments that mirror sampled endpoint traffic to target deployments without affecting client responses. Set `includeTargets=true` to include target details inline.

schema.description: Maximum number of shadow experiments to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous shadow experiment list response.
Whether to include target deployments in each returned shadow experiment.

DE.ListShadowExperimentsResponse.description: Response containing shadow experiments and pagination metadata.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Null if there are no more results.

DE.ShadowExperiment.description: Experiment that mirrors sampled endpoint requests to target deployments without changing client responses.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the experiment was created.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the principal that created the experiment.

endpointId.description: Output only. Endpoint whose traffic this experiment samples.

etag.description: Opaque version tag for optimistic concurrency control. Returned on read; set it on update or delete requests for consistent read-modify-write.

id.description: Output only. Unique shadow experiment identifier.

name.description: Human-readable shadow experiment name, unique within the endpoint. At most 256 characters.

projectId.description: Output only. Project that owns the parent endpoint.

source.description: Endpoint source and sampling configuration for mirrored requests.

state.description: Derived serving state, active when the experiment has at least one target.

targets.description: Target deployments that receive mirrored traffic.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the experiment was last updated.

DE.ShadowExperimentSourceResponse.description: Endpoint traffic source returned for a shadow experiment.

endpoint.description: Endpoint-level source that samples traffic at the API gateway.

DE.ShadowExperimentTarget.description: Deployment that receives mirrored traffic for a shadow experiment.

createdAt.description: Output only. Timestamp when the target was created.

etag.description: Opaque version tag for optimistic concurrency control. Returned on read; set it on update or delete requests for consistent read-modify-write.

experimentId.description: Output only. Shadow experiment this target belongs to.

id.description: Output only. Unique shadow experiment target identifier.

name.description: Human-readable target name, unique within the shadow experiment. At most 256 characters.

targetDeploymentId.description: Deployment under the parent endpoint that receives mirrored traffic. It must not be a live traffic-split member or the source or target of an active rollout; traffic-split weight 0 warm-up targets are allowed.

updatedAt.description: Output only. Timestamp when the target was last updated.

DE.ShadowExperimentEndpointSourceRespons.description: Endpoint-level source returned for a shadow experiment.

sampling.description: Resolved sampling strategy applied to endpoint traffic.

DE.ShadowExperimentSamplingResponse.description: Sampling strategy returned for endpoint-level shadow traffic.

keyBased.description: Fixed sampling by a sticky request key.

adaptiveUniform.description: Adaptive random sampling toward a target QPS.

adaptiveKeyBased.description: Adaptive sticky-key sampling toward a target QPS.

DE.ShadowExperimentUniformSamplingRespon.description: Fixed-rate random sampling returned by the API. A zero rate may be omitted by JSON serialization.

rate.description: Fraction of requests sampled, from 0.0 to 1.0.

DE.ShadowExperimentKeyBasedSamplingRespo.description: Fixed-rate sticky-key sampling returned by the API. A zero rate may be omitted by JSON serialization.

key.description: Request-body field used as the sticky sampling key.

rate.description: Fraction of distinct key values sampled, from 0.0 to 1.0.

DE.ShadowExperimentAdaptiveUniformSampli.description: Adaptive random sampling returned by the API.

window.description: Sliding window for QPS observation when explicitly configured.

DE.ShadowExperimentAdaptiveKeyBasedSampl.description: Adaptive sticky-key sampling returned by the API.

key.description: Request-body field used as the sticky sampling key.

window.description: Sliding window for QPS observation when explicitly configured.
